goal: Keep semantic image generation on the native imagegen route for single, serial, parallel, and multi-image requests; avoid local Python/bash generation fallback and avoid hardcoded remount or tasks-only flows.
rootCause: Image generation was documented as a native imagegen route, but batch guidance in multiple prompts/contracts still hardcoded imagegen.tasks as the batch path.
Tool schema budgeting could still expose bash alongside imagegen, and long-context schema-only recovery could disable all tool schemas for the next turn.
When imagegen was not visible, the shell guard blocked local scripts but did not expose enough tool-visibility context for the model to reason about capability recovery.

changes: Expand imagegen intent detection for multi-image, one-by-one generation, product carousel, and numeric image-count phrasing.
When imagegen intent is detected and imagegen is available, select imagegen as the primary schema route and do not expose bash as a competing semantic image-generation path.
When imagegen intent is detected but imagegen is missing, expose diagnostics/capability tools instead of bash so the model can inspect visibility and recovery evidence.
Prevent recent tool-chain selection from re-adding bash/shell/terminal after an imagegen intent has already narrowed the schema route.
Return immediately after imagegen-intent schema selection so small custom toolset and fallback expansion cannot re-add unrelated tools.
Ignore explicit non-imagegen tool mentions during an imagegen turn when imagegen is visible, so read/custom_renderer or other non-diagnostic tools cannot compete with the native imagegen route.
Exclude env_config from the imagegen-missing diagnostic route to avoid prompting local provider configuration probing.
Exclude vision and OCR from pure image-generation schema selection; those capabilities must not compete with the native imagegen route for semantic generation.

Narrow raw-shell semantic image-generation detection so deterministic PIL/SVG/canvas post-processing such as contact sheets, labels, resize of generated outputs, masks, and format conversion remains allowed.
Keep imagegen schema available during context-overflow schema-only recovery for image-generation turns instead of forcing a text-only retry.
Update raw-shell reroute guidance to allow one or more imagegen tool calls according to visible schema, not a fixed tasks-array or remount flow.
Replace tasks-only batch guidance with Codex-style native imagegen tool routing.
Clarify that local Python/PIL/HTML/SVG/canvas is only for deterministic post-processing, not semantic final image generation.
Document that batches may use multiple imagegen calls or the optional tasks field according to visible schema and requested ordering.
Keep tasks support as an optional native batch loop rather than the only valid multi-image route.
Remove imagegen.tasks-only failure prompt guidance from the imagegen capability contract.
